summary: The clocked host GOMP call invokes the persistent count-taking worker. It partitions rows, executes each row's complete CSR interval for every requested iteration, accumulates indexed products and stores outputs; per-pass barrier and repetition control are present in the full worker.

source_evidence.claim: Complete exact OpenMP build configuration, including compile/link flags.
Complete source file contains runtime count/dimensions, CSR initialization and the persistent row kernel.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked GOMP_parallel target and full outlined worker include repetition, row/nonzero traversal, arithmetic, stores and barrier.
